description: We accept old cars of all brands. The evaluated value is adjusted against your new car payment, plus an exchange bonus up to Rs. 25,000 depending on the new model chosen. Free evaluation takes 30-45 minutes.

name: Home Delivery Service
description: Get your new car delivered to your doorstep within the city at no extra charge. Inform your sales advisor during booking.

description: The Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) covers your scheduled services for a fixed price, starting at Rs. 11,999 for 2 years. It protects you from service cost increases and is worth it if you service your car regularly with us.

name: Car Insurance Assistance
